main.description: Trigger the maps-bulk-ingest-gtfs-jp K8s pod to (re)ingest all curated GTFS-JP feeds (Tokyo Metro / Toei / JR West / Chuo Bus by default; full 47-pref index when GTFS_JP_FEED_INDEX_URL is configured) into vertex_spatial as Railway / BusRoute / Station / BusStop. Usually fired by the timer-start BPMN of the same name (R/PT24H).

feedIndexUrl.description: Optional one-shot override for GTFS_JP_FEED_INDEX_URL — JSON array of {feed_id,url,prefecture,agency}.

limitFeeds.description: Optional one-shot cap on number of feeds processed (dev / smoke runs).

podStatus.description: HTTP status returned by the dumper /trigger endpoint.
